notes.title: 0.7.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.7.2 Patch Notes

• Card Attack Animations  
• New Music  
• Updated UI Elements  
• Dialogue Window Enhancements  
• Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements

Card Attack Animations  
- Number cards now visually "attack" Royals before disappearing from the screen.  
This small visual detail adds a bit more flair and feedback to every strike!

New Music  
- Additional Clemency Music tracks have been added to various Chapter 3 stages.  
More variety, more atmosphere, more immersion.

Updated UI Elements  

 The Discard Button has been moved to the left side of the player’s hand.  
 It now only appears when a card is actively selected.  
 The button has also been changed to [color=red]red[/color] for better visibility.  
 Sizes of various UI buttons have been increased to improve legibility.  
 Tooltips have been added to Menu UI elements for added clarity.


Dialogue Window Enhancements  
- The dialogue box color has been updated to a darker blue tone.  
- It can now be repositioned on the screen (dev-side feature for future tutorials).  
- You must now click directly on the dialogue box to progress the message.  
This change allows for better interaction with game elements like cards during tutorial sequences.

Bug Fixes  

 Fixed a bug where X2/X3 cards could be used without a damage card selected — this also caused the next number card played to vanish incorrectly.  
 Save/Load system now keeps scores properly separated across different game modes.  
 Music volume settings are now preserved correctly between stages.  
 Fixed an issue where playing multiple X2/X3 cards caused only the first one to be destroyed, while the others remained selected — which could lead to negative score modifiers on the next play.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.7.0 & 0.7.1
notes.content:
Version 0.7.0 Patch Notes

• Progression System Implemented  
• New Music  
• Updated UI Elements  
• Dialogue Window System  
• "Continue" Saved Game Functionality  
• Bug Fixes & Quality-of-Life Improvements

Progression System  
A new progression system has been added!  
You must now beat a chapter on a specific game mode to unlock the next chapter for that mode.  
Example: Beating Chapter 1 on Normal unlocks Chapter 2 Normal.  
Currently, all game modes are unlocked for Chapter 1, but this may change in the future.

New Music  
- The main menu now features brand-new music that better matches the dungeon-themed atmosphere.  
- The previous track was a bit too cheerful — this new one fits the tone much better.

Updated UI Elements  
- A number of UI button graphics have been updated.  
- While not all have been replaced yet, the majority are now using the new style. More updates coming soon!

Dialogue Window System  
- A custom dialogue system is now in place.  
- The current visuals are placeholder, but it functions as the foundation for the upcoming tutorial overhaul.  
- You can preview the system in action on the Tutorial menu.

Continue Saved Game  
- The save/load system now includes a visible “Continue” button on the main menu when a save file is present.  
- This allows players to return to the start of the stage they last exited.

Example: Reaching Chapter 1 Stage 12 saves your score, combo, and other relevant data. Returning later will load you back to the beginning of that stage.

- We're also exploring the possibility of saving the exact in-progress state (mid-stage), though it would require a significant code overhaul — so it’s a long-term goal.

Bug Fixes  

 Music no longer stops when entering the Video Settings menu.  
 Skipping the credits now only works with ESC, Spacebar, or left/right mouse buttons.  
 Music volume now rounds correctly, eliminating unwanted decimal values at extreme settings.  
 Fixed issue where players couldn’t cycle left through hand skins.  
 Fixed adjacency check error in Chapter 3 Stage 10.  
 Corrected exit and entrance points in Chapter 3 Stage 12.  
 “No More Moves” now correctly detects wild cards and avoids premature game overs.  
 0.7.1 Hotfix: Fixed incorrect Menu Button graphic and stopped it from being animated at all times.

notes.title: Beta 0.6.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.6.1 Patch Notes

• Backgrounds Added  
• New Music  
• Mocking Jester (Combo News)  
• Achievement System (In Progress)  
• Particle Effects  
• Big Lick Comic Con Winners  
• Bug Fixes  

Backgrounds Added  
All gameplay stages and the main menu now feature backgrounds! These may continue to be refined and updated as we polish for release.

New Music  
Unique music has been added for the remaining Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 rooms that were previously missing it.

Mocking Jester  
Losing a combo now triggers the appearance of a jester who mocks you with his laughter.  
- Larger combo losses will now cause a world shake for dramatic effect.  
- The sound effect for a combo loss has been updated for extra sting.

Achievements (Coming Soon)  
Achievements remain disabled from Big Lick Comic Con and for developer secrecy mwuahaha.

Particle Effects  
The reward screen fireworks now include enhanced particle effects for a more dynamic celebration.

Big Lick Comic Con Winners  
The credits have been updated to include all winners of the “Beat TacoMonkeyGod’s 1 Suit Mode High Score” challenge.

Bug Fixes  

 Fixed tooltips appearing on non-flipped cards.  
 Tooltips no longer display during the pause screen.  
 Right-clicking on X2 and X3 cards no longer crashes the game.  
 Fixed “No Moves Remaining” triggering in Zen mode with a hand full of special reward cards.  
 Cards now properly move to a discard pile when played or discarded. This is used in Zen mode to prevent duplicating cards by holding them in your hand during a reshuffle.  
 Fixed adjacency check error in Chapter 4, Room 20, Slot 5.  
 Fixed Survival mode load game crash caused by a missing timer value.  
 Fixed Survival mode always starting with 3 minutes after loading a game.

notes.title: 0.6.0 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.6.0 Patch Notes

• Save / Load System  
• Randomized Stage Exits  
• Game Over Screen Enhancements  
• Achievement System (In Progress)  
• Chapter 4 Overhaul  
• Gameplay Tweaks  
• Bug Fixes

Save / Load System
A save state is now created when exiting a stage to the main menu. This saves your current score, combo, and deck at the start of the stage.  
While there's no formal "Load" button yet, you can press C on the main menu to continue your run.  
Note: The exact card order is not saved — this is intentional to prevent exploits by memorizing sequences for better scores.

Randomized Stage Exits
Stages with multiple valid exits now randomly select one at the start, adding more variety and unpredictability to each run.

Game Over Screen Enhancements
The Game Over screen now displays your final score from the current playthrough. Small touch — big motivation.

Achievements (Coming Soon)
Achievements have been added to the backend and are actively being developed. They're currently disabled — so yes, we’re kind of teasing you.

Chapter 4 Overhaul

New Music: All Chapter 4 rooms now feature updated background tracks.  
Stage Rebalancing: Several stages have revised exit paths and card flipping requirements.  
Lock & Key System: All Chapter 4 stages now use the Lock & Key mechanic. To unlock the final goal slot, you must find and remove a designated “key” card elsewhere in the pattern. The key’s position is fixed for each stage, encouraging strategic planning and learning optimal paths.


Gameplay Tweaks
- Fireworks now only appear on the reward screen if you perfectly clear the stage.

Bug Fixes
- The “One Ring” stat is now correctly tracking how many times it’s been played.

notes.title: Royal Gambit Beta 0.5.0
notes.content:
Royal’s Gambit – Patch Notes v0.5.0
This is a major update packed with long-awaited features, reward reworks, and important fixes. Let’s dive into what’s new!

📝 NEW FEATURES
• Tooltips Added
Cards now display tooltips with helpful information to improve decision-making during gameplay:

Number Cards / Rewards – Show what effect the card will have when played (damage, combo effects, point gains, etc.).

Royal Cards – Display potential point values based on how the card is defeated (exact vs. overkill).

More tooltip types are planned for future updates, including explanations for chapter mechanics and game modes.

• Deck View
On the reward screen, you can now view your current deck by clicking the deck or pressing the Right Stick on your controller. No more guessing or trying to remember your build—track your journey with ease.

• Reward Shaders
Reward cards now feature distinct shader effects for added visual flair. This helps differentiate new card types and adds style to your choices.

• New Settings Options
We’ve expanded the options menu with several highly requested features:

Sound Effects Volume – Adjust SFX volume independently.

Toggle Damage Display – Show or hide the total damage value for added challenge. Great for educational use—encouraging mental math!

Music Playlist Mode – Instead of looping one song per stage, playlist mode cycles through the chapter’s full soundtrack. (Note: not available in Survival Mode due to current music handling.)

🎁 REWARDS OVERHAUL
This update brings three brand-new reward types, adding 108 new cards total. Here’s what’s new:

Point Cards
Earn points equal to the card’s number when played—amplified by your current combo. For example, a 9 Point Card played at a 3x combo deals 9 damage and earns 27 points.

Number Combo Cards
Instantly boost your combo by the value of the card. These are perfect for recovering from a drop or stacking big bonuses.

Wild Cards
Playable against any Royal suit. Simple. Versatile. Deadly.

Updated: X2 / X3 Cards → Point Multiplier Cards
Damage multiplier cards have been reworked. Instead of boosting raw damage (which rarely aligned with the exact-kill system), these now multiply the points earned from a kill:

Use a x2 or x3 card on a killing blow to multiply the total score after combo and exact kill bonuses are calculated.
This makes them a powerful tool for high-score strategies.

Overall, these new and reworked rewards provide more meaningful choices and better synergy with different game modes.

🐛 BUG FIXES
Adjacency Fixes:

 Room 3 – Fixed
 Room 7 – Fixed
 Room 9 – Fixed
 Room 10 & Demo Room 18 – Adjusted
 Room 14 & Demo Room 20 – Fixed
 Room 17 – Adjusted
 Room 19 – Adjusted


General Fixes:

 Fixed a bug where the game would end with a "no moves" message even after defeating the objective Royal.
 Fixed false-positive 'no moves remaining' detection logic.
 Score formatting added to High Score display on the main menu.
 Fixed an issue where the stage timer would shrink while score points were floating.
 Fixed main menu score display not updating when switching chapters or game modes.
 Fixed a controller navigation bug on the main menu that caused erratic highlight behavior.
 Fixed an issue where multiple cards would discard unintentionally when using a controller.
 Players can no longer play cards after the stage-ending card has been destroyed.
 Fixed a bug allowing card selection while paused using the controller’s A button.
 You can now skip the victory/credits screen using Start or B on the controller.


This is one of our most substantial updates yet—improving usability, strategy, and presentation across the board. Thank you for playing and keep sending your feedback!

Bug Fixes: 

 Fixed false positive no moves remain game over.
 Fixed a bug where the timer would shrink while points were floating to the score.
 Added score formatting to High Score on main menu.
 Chapter 4 Adjacency Logic:
 -Fixed adjacency logic for Chapter 4 Room 7
 -Fixed adjacency logic for Chapter 4 Room 9
 -Adjusted adjacency logic for Chapter 4 Room 10 & Demo Room 18
 -Fixed adjacency logic for Chapter 4 Room 14 & Demo Room 20
 -Adjusted adjacency logic for Chapter 4 Room 17
 -Adjusted adjacency logic for Chapter 4 Room 19
 Fixed a bug where if you have no moves remaining when taking out the objective royal it would end the game saying no moves remain.
 Fixed adjacency logic for Chapter 4 Room 3

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1.1
notes.content:
Version 0.4.1.1 Patch Notes
•	Graphics Updates
•	Audio Settings Menu
•	Tutorial Added
•	New Chapter 3 Audio
•	Zen Mode Changes
•	Survival Mode Changes
•	Controller Updates
•	Bug Fixes

Graphics Updates

The game now detects your monitor resolution and adjusts to the size of your screen in a borderless windowed mode. This ensures a seamless visual experience tailored to your display.

Simple Skin updated to contain suit symbols.

Plebes Skin recolored to match the same color scheme as all other skins. This update ensures visual consistency across all skins, making mix-and-match combinations clearer during gameplay.

A new splash screen logo added.

Chapter text now displays in game.

Adjusted the position of Score, Damage and Combo values on the screen.

Fireworks added to the reward selection screen.

Score values when destroying a royal card now float up and toward the score. Score values now increment smoothly toward their new total, providing clearer visual feedback.

Score is now displayed with commas to make more readable.

Changed the card back of the simple skin.

Audio Settings Menu

New settings menu for audio settings added. You can adjust the volume of music. Sound effects volume control: Coming soon!

Audio settings added to pause menu.

Tutorial

A foundational tutorial has been implemented, currently presented as a slideshow. We are actively working on a more interactive version for future updates!

New Chapter 3 Audio

Clemency Music tracks have been added to Chapter 3 stages. More will come in the future.

Zen Mode Changes

Zen Mode now recycles your deck once it is empty. You are still allowed to play any suit against any suit. It’s intended to be a mode to just play and not have to worry about strategy as much or running out of cards.

Survival Mode Changes

Music now changes at 1 minute mark instead of 2:30.

Controller Updates

Controller navigation added to Audio Settings Menu

Controller navigation added to Skin Selection Menu

Controller navigation added to Video Settings Menu

Controller navigation added to Stats Menu

Added music volume controls mapped to Left and Right Shoulder Buttons.

Bug Fixes

Fixed various issues with controller support not selecting certain menu items (back button). There are still some wonky controller behaviors that need to be looked at.

Beta Message and Splash screen now skippable with controller A button or “Select” 

Fixed audio group bug where credits music wouldn’t play except for when beating Chapter 1.

Clicking menu buttons before they are fully loaded no longer crashes the game.


 One Ring Card Fixes


      One Ring bug fixed where the next card isn’t destroyed.
      Fixed a bug where the one ring card wouldn’t destroy number cards when played together.
      Fixed a bug when selecting one ring and then selecting X2/X3 damage card wouldn’t allow you to play it against a royal card.

Fixed a bug when you pause the game it would reset your score to 0.

Fixed logic miscalculations for Chapter 2 rooms 4, 6, 10, 14, 19.

Fixed graphic effects being disabled when pausing in tutorial screen.

Fixed a bug where cycling through the hand skins via right arrow wouldn’t cycle back to the first skin.

Fixed the issue where “None” would display as the reason on game over screen.

notes.title: 0.4.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.4.0.0 Patch Notes
•	Improved Menu Controller Support
•	Reward Screen Suit Counter
•	No Moves Left Detection
•	Game Over Screen Improvements
•	Royal Animations
•	New Music
•	Bug Fixes

Improved Menu Controller Support
Menu controller system has been updated to use a similar system that the core game uses for input. Not all menus are fully supported yet such as Skin Selection and Video Settings menus. Controller should be completely usable for core gameplay as well as navigating pause menu and sub menus of that.

Reward Screen Suit Counter
On the reward screen you can now see a count of how many of the different suits you currently have in your deck. No more trying to remember if you’ve picked more than another suit to add to your deck from previous stages.

No Moves Left Detection
A new system has been added to check your current hand and cards not yet drawn remaining in your deck. If it detects that you have no possible moves to progress the stage further it will trigger game over state.

Game Over Screen Improvements
Music and sound effects on the Game Over screen have been added. As well as a message to display on why you lost. The screen will stay there until you press a key on your keyboard, left click the mouse, press the A button your controller or the game over song finishes playing.

Royal Animations
Royal cards now have animations. Watch them squirm as you decide your next move!

New Music
Chapter 2 levels have had some new songs added from Clemency Music. These songs were made specifically for Royal’s Gambit by him.

Bug Fixes
Your deck has been one spade card short. We apologize for this; it has been added back.
